```{r}
start_time <- Sys.time()
```

```{r}
library(missForest)
library(mice)
library(VIM)
library(ISLR)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(kernlab)
```

# Credit dataset

```{r}
# Original complete dataset
data(Credit)
credit_original <- Credit

# Run one comparison for a particular missingness level
compare_methods <- function(missing_rate, seed) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Generate ONE dataset with missing values.
  # All methods receive exactly this same dataset.
  x_mis <- prodNA(credit_original, noNA = missing_rate)
  
  # 1. MissForest
  set.seed(seed)
  imp_missforest <- missForest(
    x_mis,
    maxiter = 10
  )$ximp
  
  
  # 2.. KNN
  imp_knn <- VIM::kNN(
    x_mis,
    k = 5,
    imp_var = FALSE
  )
  
  # 4. MICE
  set.seed(seed)
  imp_mice <- mice(
    x_mis,
    m = 1,
    maxit = 5,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )
  imp_mice <- complete(imp_mice, 1)
  
  # Calculate errors at the artificially missing positions
  methods <- list(
    MissForest = imp_missforest,
    KNN = imp_knn,
    MICE = imp_mice
  )
  
  results <- lapply(names(methods), function(method) {
    
    error <- mixError(
      ximp = methods[[method]],
      xmis = x_mis,
      xtrue = credit_original
    )
    
    data.frame(
      Missing = missing_rate,
      Method = method,
      NRMSE = unname(error["NRMSE"]),
      PFC = unname(error["PFC"])
    )
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, results)
}

# Run the experiments
simulation_results <- list()
counter <- 1

for (rate in c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30)) {
  for (sim in 1:50) {
    
    simulation_results[[counter]] <-
      compare_methods(
        missing_rate = rate,
        seed = 81 + sim
      )
    
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

results <- do.call(rbind, simulation_results)

# Display results
print(results)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

average_results <- results %>%
  group_by(Missing, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    NRMSE = mean(NRMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    PFC = mean(PFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(average_results)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)   # ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr

plot_data <- average_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NRMSE, PFC),
               names_to = "Measure", values_to = "Error") %>%
  mutate(Missing = factor(Missing, labels = paste0(sort(unique(Missing)) * 100, "% missing")))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Method, y = Error, fill = Measure)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Error, 2)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Missing) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(NRMSE = "blue", PFC = "red")) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of imputation methods, Credit dataset",
       subtitle = "NRMSE (numeric variables) and PFC (categorical variables)",
       x = NULL, y = "Error", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
